npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00620_FourGoblets/31919-01.html.text: Ghost Chamberlain of Elmoreden: Ah, you're helping him, eh? I'm not that strong anymore, but I've broken a seal or two! Unfortunately, when I try to do it now, it rarely works! I've started breaking quite a few boxes, too! But if you don't mind the risk, I'll try to open the box for you.

Q00620_FourGoblets/31919-02.html.text: Ghost Chamberlain of Elmoreden: Wow! Something came out of it!

Q00620_FourGoblets/31919-03.html.text: Ghost Chamberlain of Elmoreden: Hmm. The box is empty.

Q00620_FourGoblets/31919-04.html.text: Ghost Chamberlain of Elmoreden: I'm so sorry! The box just disintegrated!

Q00620_FourGoblets/31919-05.html.text: Ghost Chamberlain of Elmoreden: I don't see a box... Come back when you find one!
